text:
Rae (Design): Quick copy review: delete deployment confirmation. Current modal header: "Delete deployment?" body: "This will remove the deployment and its data. This action cannot be undone." primary="Delete" secondary="Cancel". Tickets say users accidentally clicked delete when they meant to pause. Need clearer wording + undo affordance. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.mock/snap/delete-deploy.png

Omar (ENG): Backend deletes are soft for 7 days (can restore), but UI currently says permanently gone. We should be accurate. Also we have a delete countdown of 10s in place. Could present that as "Deleting in 10s" with an undo link.

Samira (A11y): Use explicit verbs and avoid fear language. Suggest header: "Confirm delete deployment" Body: "This will schedule the deployment for deletion in 10 seconds. You can undo this action within 7 days by restoring from the 삭제 archive." (replace 삭제 with proper copy). Make sure the undo link is keyboard accessible and announceable via aria-live.

Ben (PM): Product prefers we emphasize recoverability to reduce panic. Proposed short copy: "Schedule deletion of this deployment" body: "The deployment will be deleted after 10 seconds and can be restored for 7 days. To cancel, click Undo." Primary CTA: "Delete" (danger) Secondary: "Cancel". Also track metric whether users use undo.

Rae (Design): Revised microcopy options: Option A (direct): Header: "Delete deployment" Body: "This deployment will be deleted in 10 seconds and can be restored within 7 days." CTAs: Primary "Delete now" Secondary "Cancel". Option B (soft): Header: "Schedule deletion" Body: "We'll remove this deployment in 10s. You can undo or restore from the archive for 7 days." Primary "Confirm" Secondary "Cancel".

Omar (ENG): Implementation: we'll change wording to mention 7-day restore and add an inline undo toast after deletion with keyboard focus. Also ensure the countdown is visible and stops if modal closed.

Samira (A11y): A11y notes: 1) Announce the countdown via aria-live region updated every second (polite) until it reaches zero. 2) When deletion completes, present a toast with role="status": "Deployment deleted. [Undo]" where Undo is focusable. 3) Keep focus management: return focus to the list if user cancels.

Ben (PM): I like Option A with "Delete now" as primary. Also add a small helper text under body: "Need to pause instead? Use Pause in the deployment menu." to reduce misclicks.

Rae (Design): Finalizing copy for PR: Header: "Delete deployment" Body: "This deployment will be deleted in 10 seconds and can be restored for 7 days. Need to pause instead? Use Pause from the deployment menu." Primary: "Delete now" Secondary: "Cancel" Toast text: "Deployment deleted. [Undo]". I'll add microcopy to the component story.

Omar (ENG): PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/5234	4 includes countdown aria-live, toast undo, and tests. Preview: https://preview.redwood-internal/mock/delete-deploy/v1 (expires 24h) :rocket:

Samira (A11y): I'll review focus and live region behavior. Quick nit: use "restore" rather than "recover" for consistency.

Rae (Design): Thanks all  merging after a11y sign-off.
